title: maint.event.v1{kind=denylist_decimate_now}
description: Phase 8 §8.8 — operator forces an immediate run of the denylist decimation sweeper (normally fires when the Redis denylist crosses `cfg.sec_denylist_decimate_threshold`). `target` is the sweep scope; 'all' means every denylist key.

target.description: Scope: 'all' or a specific subject prefix.
